Ritika Qureshi
Accountant / Finance Professional | Bengaluru
ritika.qureshi48@example.com | +91 9229825045

Detail-oriented finance professional with a strong foundation in accounting systems and process optimization. Experienced in managing accounts payable cycles, reconciliations, and implementing controls across ERP and legacy tools. Collaborative team member who improves accuracy and reduces processing time through automation and disciplined workflows. Notice period: 90 days.

Experience

HCLTech — Apr 2024 - Present
Accountant (On-site)
- Managed Accounts Payable processing in SAP FICO, executing vendor invoice posting, three-way matching and payment runs, reducing late payments by 18% in six months.
- Performed monthly AP reconciliations and resolved discrepancies, improving vendor statement clearance rate from 82% to 96%.
- Streamlined invoice tracking using Confluence pages and standardized templates, cutting invoice query turnaround time by 25%.
- Maintained accurate ledgers and supported SAP FICO month-end activities, contributing to a 15% faster close for AP sub-ledger.

Wipro — Dec 2023 - Mar 2024
Accounts Manager (Hybrid)
- Oversaw Accounts Payable operations, processing high-volume supplier invoices and ensuring GST-compliant invoicing and tax treatment, resulting in zero GST filing discrepancies during tenure.
- Reconciled vendor balances using MS Excel pivot tables and VLOOKUPs to identify and clear aged payables, lowering DPO variance by 12%.
- Implemented standardized AP spreadsheets and checklists, reducing invoice posting errors by 20%.
- Coordinated with procurement and vendors to resolve billing disputes, improving vendor satisfaction metrics.

Capgemini — Mar 2022 - Nov 2023
Accounts Manager (On-site)
- Managed day-to-day accounting tasks using Tally and MS Excel for multiple service lines, including ledger maintenance and supplier payments, achieving 98% on-time payment rate.
- Prepared detailed Excel-based reports and dashboards to track payable aging and cash requirements, enabling more accurate cash forecasting and a 10% reduction in short-term funding needs.
- Conducted monthly reconciliations and supported audits with organized Tally extracts, reducing audit queries by 30%.
- Documented process notes in Confluence to standardize handovers and improve training ramp-up time for new hires.

Projects

AP Automation Pilot — Capgemini
- Led a pilot to semi-automate invoice data extraction into Tally and Excel workflows, reducing manual invoice entry time by ~40% and decreasing posting errors.

Vendor Reconciliation Toolkit — Wipro
- Built Excel reconciliation templates and macros to accelerate vendor statement matching, cutting reconciliation time per vendor from ~3 hours to under 1 hour.

Skills

Accounting Tools: Tally, SAP FICO
Tax & Compliance: GST, Accounts Payable
Productivity: MS Excel, Confluence
Technical: Linux, Git

Education

M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
